upload_url.description_en: The upload URL. The URL is valid for 15 minutes by default. If the URL expires, you must call the GetUploadUrl operation again to obtain a new one. If you enable the intelligent data domain feature, the value of internal_upload_url is adaptively returned in this field based on the request
upload_url.description_zh:
上传地址，默认有效时间15分钟，如果链接超时，需要重新调用GetUploadUrl进行获取
（开启智能数据域名后，根据请求会自适应返回internal_upload_url值在该字段内）
upload_url.title: 上传地址

description_en: Lists the parts that have been successfully uploaded for a specific multipart upload
description_zh: 列举已上传成功的多段
name: ListUploadedParts

parameters.help_en: The drive ID. Required for all scenarios except uploads from a share
parameters.help_zh: 空间 id，除根据分享链接上传之外的其他场景，必填
parameters.name: drive_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of parts to return. The value cannot exceed 100. The default is 100
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回100，最大不能超过100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The marker that specifies the position after which to start listing parts. Obtain this value from the `next_part_number_marker` field in a previous response. If this parameter is omitted, the listing starts from the first part
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回。如果不设定，则从头开始返回数据。 默认值：无
parameters.name: part_number_marker

parameters.help_en: The share ID. Required when uploading from a share
parameters.help_zh: 分享 id，当根据分享链接上传时必填
parameters.name: share_id

next_part_number_marker.description_en: The marker for the next page of results. This value is empty when there are no more results to return
next_part_number_marker.description_zh: 下一页起始资源标识符, 最后一页该值为空

parallel_upload.description_en: Indicates whether parallel upload is enabled
